column1: # source: real market data + Maker post-mortem
# incident: Black Thursday ETH crash + oracle lag
# class: CORRELATED congestion - push oracles stale while market crashes 43%
# sources_wrong: several stale + real crash ongoing
# notes: ETH dropped from ~$196 to ~$112 (43%) on March 12-13
#   Network congestion caused push oracles (Chainlink) to lag significantly.
#   OSM 1h delay compounded: Maker's OSM was reporting $196 while market was at $112.
#   Thousands of vaults were liquidated at incorrect prices; $0 DAI auctions occurred.
#   Pyth/RedStone reconstructed as truth-following (they didn't exist but represent what
#   a faster oracle would have reported).
#   OracleGuard in this scenario: several stale → RED (minting frozen)
